fieldNotes.location: Roster address (3800 Fairchild St) is incorrect — that parcel (0839720000R, owned by First Global Import & Export) is a 5.95-acre junk yard / open-storage lot, confirmed by Florida Parcels land-use record and Street View. The actual KDP Jacksonville Distribution Center is at 2300 Pickettville Rd, Jacksonville FL 32220, coords 30.3522,-81.76505. Confirmed by KDP brand mural (A&W, RC, Snapple) on the building wall and a 'Keurig Dr Pepper Visitor & Vendor Entrance' sign at the gate.
fieldNotes.facility: 598,587 sq ft cross-dock distribution warehouse built 2009 (former Hillwood spec building); KDP southeast distribution hub; 32' clear height. Per leasing records: 128 dock doors, 326 car spaces, 118 trailer parking spaces.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entry — driveway painted 'GATE 2' with a sliding chain-link gate across the truck lane; KDP visitor/vendor sign. Numbered gates imply at least 2 truck gates (truckGateCount 2).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly staffed multi-window guard booth visible at the Gate 2 entrance in 2025 Street View; a small gate-control kiosk/structure sits beside the lane. Treated as remote/kiosk check-in (remoteGs true) — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band — leasing records cite 128 dock doors; trailers backed in along BOTH long building faces, confirmed in z18/z20 satellite.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: true — distinct dock banks on the east and west building faces (cross-dock layout).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer staging along both dock aprons plus a large trailer storage/parking yard off the north end (~118 trailer capacity).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entry apron and deep dock aprons (3+ truck stacking) — room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs west of the property but is separated by a drainage canal; no spur enters the site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: West Jacksonville industrial corridor inside the metro, near I-10 — Urban.

citations.claim: Active KDP Jacksonville reqs (warehouse picker, maintenance mechanic, fleet mechanic) tied to the Pickettville DC.
598,587 sq ft KDP DC at 2300 Pickettville Rd sold to Hillwood in a sale-leaseback; KDP remains the operating tenant, 128 dock doors / 118 trailer spaces.

verification.rationale: Building sold to investors but KDP is the leaseback tenant; on-site KDP brand mural + visitor/vendor signage and active KDP reqs confirm current operation. Tenancy = leased.
